title: Rental Property Service Contracts Late-Billed Installment Worksheet
content:
**The installment.** The monthly installment for a billing period of a monthly-billed Rental Property Service Contracts contract that fell due and was never billed is billed as one monthly installment for that period, due on the period start. It is the base monthly amount of the tier in force for the period billed, reduced by the term's portfolio discount rate, and rounded to the cent once at the end.

**A. The period billed.** The period billed is the one that starts the day after the last billed installment's period ends.

**B. The tier in force for the period.** The tier in force for the period billed is the tier the contract held before its most recent tier change when that change was made on or after the period's start date, because a new tier's installment is billed only from the next billing period, and is otherwise the tier the contract holds.

**C. The base monthly amount.** The tier's monthly premium plus its additional-unit premium for each unit beyond the first, on the contract's unit count.
- For the tier the contract holds, the figures are those on the product's premium rate card.
- For the tier held before the most recent tier change (the prior tier on the contract): Bridgewell Rental Appliance $42.99; Bridgewell Rental Systems $47.99; Bridgewell Rental Combo $64.99; Bridgewell Rental Multi-Unit Combo $69.99 plus $39.99 for each unit beyond the first.

**D. The term's portfolio discount rate.** For an installment that fell due and was never billed, the term's portfolio discount rate is the rate recorded on the installment for the term's first billing period, instead of counting the portfolio again, and only for such an installment; every other premium remains under the portfolio discount terms.

## Records

| Quantity | Read from |
|---|---|
| Last billed installment's period end | the latest monthly installment charge in the billing history |
| Tier held, prior tier, most recent plan change date, unit count, term start date | the contract |
| Term's portfolio discount rate | the installment whose billing period starts on the term start date |

## Worked examples (hypothetical contracts, term starting 15 January, first installment recording a rate of 0.05)

1. Last billed period 15 April to 14 May; the contract moved from Bridgewell Rental Systems to Bridgewell Rental Combo on 20 May. The period billed starts 15 May; the change on 20 May is on or after 15 May, so the tier in force is Bridgewell Rental Systems: $47.99 reduced by 0.05 is $45.5905, rounded to **$45.59**.
2. Same contract, but the change was made on 3 May: before the period start, so the tier in force is Bridgewell Rental Combo: $64.99 reduced by 0.05 is $61.7405, **$61.74**.
3. No tier change: a three-unit Bridgewell Rental Multi-Unit Combo contract, $149.97 reduced by 0.05 is $142.4715, **$142.47**.
